description: This file defines a controller class for the Flat Shipping extension in the Opencart admin panel. It manages the display and saving of flat shipping configurations, including loading language files, setting up view data, and handling permission checks.

classes.name: Flat
classes.description: Controller class for managing the flat rate shipping extension in the admin interface of Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the flat shipping extension, setting up breadcrumbs, loading necessary data, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the flat shipping configuration settings, including permission checks and returning success or error messages in JSON format.
